name: Firecracker
description: AWS's open-source microVM monitor powering Lambda and Fargate.
descriptionZh: AWS 开源的 microVM 虚拟机监控器，支撑 Lambda 与 Fargate。
keyFact: Firecracker is AWS's Apache-2.0 open-source microVM monitor (Rust) that underpins AWS Lambda and Fargate; it boots a microVM in about 125ms and uses under 5 MiB of memory overhead per VM.
keyFactZh: Firecracker 是 AWS 以 Apache-2.0 开源的 microVM 监控器（Rust），是 AWS Lambda 与 Fargate 的底层；其 microVM 启动约 125ms，每个 VM 内存开销低于 5 MiB。
